headline: Oil Prices Fall as Prospects for US-Iran Diplomacy Resurface
summary: Brent crude for January settlement fell 3.1% to $109.88 a barrel following reports that Donald Trump may be open to diplomatic engagement with Iran.
why: Iran is a major crude oil producer, and shifts in diplomatic relations directly influence market expectations of global oil supply.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Potential diplomatic progress eased concerns regarding Middle Eastern supply disruptions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Signs of potential US-Iran diplomatic talks lowered risk premiums built into global crude pricing.
